# Web Development

Design, build, and reliably deliver web pages that render correctly and return a shareable link. The hard part of web delivery is not writing HTML — it is guaranteeing the *published* page renders with every asset intact. This skill encodes that discipline.

## When to use this skill

- Create a new website, landing page, portfolio, dashboard, or documentation site
- Redesign or restyle an existing page
- Recreate ("clone") a page from a reference URL, then customize it
- Produce a new version of a page you previously built
- Audit and fix a page that renders blank, has broken images, or dead links

## Tools this skill uses

| Tool | Used for |
|------|----------|
| `create_file` | Write the initial `index.html` / CSS / JS into the project folder |
| `edit_file` | **The mandatory editor.** AI-applied edits using `// ... existing code ...` markers around the changed lines |
| `str_replace` | Surgical single-occurrence replacement when `edit_file` is overkill |
| `full_file_rewrite` | Replace an entire file (last resort, or template-slide rewrites) |
| `execute_command` | Download assets, run the quality-gate checks, `node --check` JS |
| `image_search` | Find topic-specific imagery (batch: `query=["…","…"]`, `num_results`) |
| `image_edit_or_generate` | Generate custom imagery/logos (`mode="generate"`) |
| `ab_navigate` / `ab_screenshot` / `ab_exec` | Drive a real browser for the Visual Check |
| `understand_image` | Read a screenshot back to confirm the page rendered correctly |

## File organization (non-negotiable)

A correct directory layout is what makes assets resolve after publishing.

- Every page project lives in its own folder: `create_file("webpages/<project>/index.html", …)`. Never write a bare `index.html` at the workspace root — it collides with other tasks and is not persisted.
- All images/media go in `webpages/<project>/images/` and are referenced **relatively** in HTML (`images/hero.jpg`). Files outside the project folder are dropped at publish time.
- Names must match `^[a-z0-9_-]+$` — lowercase, hyphen/underscore only, no spaces or non-ASCII.

## Editing discipline

- **One file per request.*
